title: Sharing
status: draft: written 19 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 2 Christian Religious Education; not yet checked by a CRE teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child names items shared at school and says sharing shows kindness, while personal items are kept for health.

floor.prerequisite: Knows items shared and not shared at home.
floor.question: Should a toothbrush be shared?

steps: Name items we do not share.

board.do: Wait for the child to say no.

misconceptions.repair: Walk around the class naming shared things.

misconceptions.ask: Is taking a friend's crayon without asking sharing?
Should you share with a new pupil?
misconceptions.repair: Talk about how a new pupil feels. Share with all.

misconceptions.ask: Should you drink from your friend's water bottle?
misconceptions.repair: Show pouring into a cup instead.

checks.question: Name an item shared at school.
